The '''''Crystal Runner''''' was a [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|CEC]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]]. It operated in the [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], transporting lightly glowing crystals.
